shortDescription: The Reserve Bank of India sees banks’ reliance on a small number of common technology providers as a potential risk to financial stability, according to Deputy Governor Rohit Jain, Bloomberg reported.

title: GEOPOLITICS | RBI Flags Shared Tech Vendors as Stability Risk
